day_shape: 52 items: Kuwait says it foiled an armed IRGC team on Bubiyan Island, IDF discloses weeklong raid north of the Litani, Hegseth grilled in Congress on the Iran war, Iran files Hague suit against US, and a 300-page 'Silenced No More' report on Oct 7 sexual violence dominates Israeli press.

threads.label: Kuwait foils alleged IRGC island raid
threads.summary: Kuwait announced it intercepted an armed Iranian team attempting to reach Bubiyan Island and captured several IRGC operatives. The Jerusalem Post and Times of Israel reported the capture; no Iranian state acknowledgement appeared in the day's regime channels.

threads.label: Lebanon front: IDF raid, Hezbollah SAM
threads.summary: The IDF said it conducted a weeklong raid on Hezbollah sites beyond the Litani River, while Hezbollah fired a surface-to-air missile at an Israeli fighter jet without hitting it. Hezbollah leader Naim Qassem called for ending direct Israel–Lebanon talks in favour of indirect negotiations.

threads.label: US Iran-war politics and Tehran's Hague suit
threads.summary: Defence Secretary Hegseth faced fresh congressional questioning on the Iran war as Trump said in a radio interview he expected Iran to halt enrichment and hand over material to the US. Defa Press said Iran filed a suit at the Hague Tribunal over US 'military aggression against nuclear facilities', sanctions and threats of force, and IRIB cited a Reuters/Ipsos poll claiming 62% of Americans say Trump has not explained the war.

threads.label: Cyber and information operations
threads.summary: Times of Israel reported Iran sent mass text messages to Israelis soliciting intelligence, and the Jerusalem Post reported an Iranian-backed group, Handala, published a target list naming dozens of IDF Egoz unit veterans. Iran International reported Iranians were told to post pro-government content to regain blocked internet or SIM access.

threads.label: Sanctions, prosecutions, economic strain
threads.summary: Australia sanctioned seven Iranian individuals and four entities over the protest crackdown and missile and shadow-banking networks, and a Bahraini court handed a woman a life sentence for ties to the IRGC. Iran International reported handwoven carpet exports have collapsed from roughly $2.5bn annually to near zero and that businesses are cutting jobs as inflation and internet curbs bite.

events.summary_en: Reuters: 62 per cent of Americans believe Trump has not explained to them the reason for war with Iran. A joint Reuters/Ipsos poll shows that a large majority of the American people feel that Trump has not presented a clear strategy regarding mounting tensions with Tehran. According to this poll conducted on Monday, only 28 per cent of participants believe that Trump has provided convincing reasons for confrontation with Iran. In contrast, 62 per cent of respondents stated that the government's objectives regarding Iran are unclear to them.

events.title_en: The consequences of war with Iran turned Japanese crisps black and white! The Guardian newspaper reported: Calbee, Japan's snacks giant, is offering its products in black and white packaging due to ink shortage caused by war with Iran.
events.summary_en: The consequences of war with Iran turned Japanese crisps black and white! The Guardian newspaper reported: Calbee, Japan's snacks giant, is offering its products in black and white packaging due to ink shortage caused by war with Iran. Calbee, the largest snack manufacturer in Japan, says that due to severe supply chain disruptions caused by military conflict with Iran, it has been forced to remove colour from the packaging of its products. The food industry giant stated: 'To maintain continued supply in the domestic market, we are forced to use simple black and white designs to prevent complete shutdown of the production line.'

events.summary_en: 'The end of war against Iran will likely come with American withdrawal'. events.title_en: Iran lodges complaint against the United States to the Hague Tribunal. The government of the Islamic Republic of Iran, by filing a lawsuit at the Hague Tribunal, has complained against the United States for 'military aggression against Iran's nuclear facilities', 'imposing economic sanctions' and 'threatening resort to force'.
events.summary_en: Iran lodges complaint against the United States to the Hague Tribunal. The government of the Islamic Republic of Iran, by filing a lawsuit at the Hague Tribunal, has complained against the United States for 'military aggression against Iran's nuclear facilities', 'imposing economic sanctions' and 'threatening resort to force'. This petition, based on the provisions of the 1981 Algiers Declarations and due to the United States' violation of international obligations in the 12-day war against Iran, was registered in the Hague Tribunal's claims between Iran and the United States in Esfand of the year 1404.

The Sepah intelligence organisation of Tehran province announced the dismantling of five organised destabilising networks linked to terrorist groups and weapons and ammunition smugglers.
events.summary_en: Blow struck by the Sepah intelligence organisation against 5 weapon smuggling networks of the Zionist regime. The Sepah intelligence organisation of Tehran province announced the dismantling of five organised destabilising networks linked to terrorist groups and weapons and ammunition smugglers. Continuing targeted intelligence and operational measures and oversight regarding the routes of illegal transfer and movement of weapon and ammunition shipments, 20 individuals in five organised destabilising networks linked to terrorist groups and weapons and ammunition smugglers were identified and eliminated. From these individuals, more than 50 firearms of various types, 70 kilograms of explosives, 2,000 rounds and related ammunition were discovered and confiscated.

events.title_en: Photograph: Discovery of smuggled and hoarded goods worth more than 4.5 billion tomans. The unnamed soldiers of the Imam of the Time in the Sepah intelligence organisation of Isfahan province, in coordination with the government enforcement organisation and in cooperation with the directorate-general of industry, mines and trade, succeeded in discovering these goods in the form of several thousand tonnes of essential goods, fuel, household appliances and petrochemical materials.
events.summary_en: Photograph: Discovery of smuggled and hoarded goods worth more than 4.5 billion tomans. The unnamed soldiers of the Imam of the Time in the Sepah intelligence organisation of Isfahan province, in coordination with the government enforcement organisation and in cooperation with the directorate-general of industry, mines and trade, succeeded in discovering these goods in the form of several thousand tonnes of essential goods, fuel, household appliances and petrochemical materials. The Sepah intelligence organisation of Isfahan province also announced: a large warehouse containing 1,680 tonnes of fibres needed for the clothing market worth approximately 1.7 billion tomans, which had not been registered in the comprehensive warehouse system, was seized and placed in safekeeping. The file of the perpetrators was referred to the judicial authorities for investigation.

events.title_en: Holding of the fortieth-day memorial ceremony for Sepahbod Mousavi at the sacred shrine of Reza and Shahcheragh. The ceremony to commemorate the fortieth day of Commander Shahid Sepahbod Syed Abdolrahim Mousavi, master of the martyrs of the armed forces, will be held tomorrow (Wednesday) from 9 a.m. in the courtyard of Goharshad at the sacred shrine of Reza (peace be upon him) in the holy city of Mashhad and at 4 p.m. at the sacred shrine of Hazrat Ahmad ibn Musa al-Kazim (peace be upon him) in Shiraz.
events.summary_en: Holding of the fortieth-day memorial ceremony for Sepahbod Mousavi at the sacred shrine of Reza and Shahcheragh. The ceremony to commemorate the fortieth day of Commander Shahid Sepahbod Syed Abdolrahim Mousavi, master of the martyrs of the armed forces, will be held tomorrow (Wednesday) from 9 a.m. in the courtyard of Goharshad at the sacred shrine of Reza (peace be upon him) in the holy city of Mashhad and at 4 p.m. at the sacred shrine of Hazrat Ahmad ibn Musa al-Kazim (peace be upon him) in Shiraz. The ceremony to commemorate the fortieth day of this honourable martyr will also be held on Thursday from 5 p.m. at the great prayer ground of the city of Ray located at the sacred shrine of Hazrat Abdolazim al-Hasani (peace be upon him). The ceremony to commemorate this valiant soldier of Iran will also be held in the holy city of Qom, the place of Sepahbod Mousavi's burial, with special programmes after sunset and Maghrib prayers.

A heavy defeat in local elections has put the British Prime Minister under pressure from Labour Party MPs; pressure that has now escalated to open calls for his resignation, placing the political future of the London government in a fog of uncertainty.
events.summary_en: Crisis in Britain's Labour Party / Starmer fighting for survival. A heavy defeat in local elections has put the British Prime Minister under pressure from Labour Party MPs; pressure that has now escalated to open calls for his resignation, placing the political future of the London government in a fog of uncertainty. Following the heavy defeat of Britain's Labour Party in local elections, Keir Starmer, the Prime Minister, has faced a wave of criticism and resignation requests from his party members and is now fighting to preserve his political position. On Monday, Starmer delivered a speech that British media described as 'fateful', taking responsibility for 'very difficult' results.
